fields.statement: QA cycle 3, binary built at 1f1a3b35 in a scratch repo on the VM with the real ~/.claude transcripts (Rex faked, RHIZA_TEST_NOW at the wall clock, load ~24): with usage.session 1000, daemon --once saved usage_hold (session, 4583485 used, limit 1000, 20% reserve) and the windows with their used. rhiza health showed warn usage with that detail and inbox one usage-reserve item; health took 0.6 s real / 0.1 s user, and strace -e openat of it opened no ~/.claude/projects file. After raising the limit, the next poll cleared the hold and opened a new session window after the reset; health (text and --json) showed 'ok usage session 1721 of 1000000000000; weekly 18945650 of 1000000000000', exactly the used the poll saved, in under 1 s, and the inbox said Nothing waits on you. With the saved session window's reset edited into the past, health showed session 0.

QA cycle 3, binary built at 1f1a3b35 in a scratch repo on the VM with the real ~/.claude transcripts (Rex faked, RHIZA_TEST_NOW at the wall clock, load ~24): daemon --once with usage.session 1000 over a session window of 4583485 tokens held (usage_hold saved, no start in the detach log); with usage.session and .weekly set to 1e12 the next poll, after the window's reset at 07:44:29Z, cleared the hold and saved a new session window starting at the first record after the reset (07:44:48Z). go test ./internal/api -run 'TestUsage|TestHealth' and the usage-* scripts pass.
